review_model_provenance: Astra parent dispatch, as confirmed by user; not inferred from assistant persona.

method.visual_inspection: Source and both chronological contact sheets inspected with view_image.
method.decode: CPU only; ffmpeg -hwaccel none; decoder/output threads 2; filter_threads and filter_complex_threads 1; sequential extraction.

scope: Exact-hash source/video visual reward gate only; no processing or integration approval.
limitations: 32 sampled frames cannot guarantee absence of every inter-sample artifact, frame-perfect smoothness, or seamless looping.
observations: Both yellow boots retain turquoise cuffs, purple spots and blue treaded soles. Umbrella retains its multicolored canopy panels, gray shaft and turquoise hook; the blue puddle stays present below.
Boots alternate small lifts/steps while the open umbrella rocks gently; brief overlap changes are consistent with the movement and both boots remain identifiable throughout all 32 samples.

Small transient gray/black splash-like specks appear beside the soles at several footfalls (for example frames 24–36 and 48–56). These are added motion accents, not missing tread or disappearing boot parts; they do not obstruct the subject.
No faces, eyes, mouths or added limbs appear. Canopy, shaft, hook, boots and puddle remain fully in-frame with stable source colors.
